requirements.title: Admin can log in with valid credentials
preconditions: Admin credentials are available via CI secret / .env
The OrangeHRM demo instance is reachable at https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com
No active session exists (storageState is clean for this test)
acceptanceCriteria: Given the login page is displayed at /web/index.php/auth/login
When the Admin enters valid username and password and clicks Login
Then the browser navigates to the dashboard at /web/index.php/dashboard/index
And the top navigation bar displays the authenticated user's name
requirements.expectedOutcome: Admin is authenticated and the dashboard page is fully loaded with no console errors

requirements.title: Admin can search for an employee by name
preconditions: Admin is authenticated (storageState)
At least one employee record exists in the system
acceptanceCriteria: Given the Admin is on the Employee List page at /web/index.php/pim/viewEmployeeList
When the Admin types a valid employee name into the search field and clicks Search
Then the results table displays only employees whose names match the search term
And when no match exists the table shows a 'No Records Found' message
requirements.expectedOutcome: Employee list filters correctly and the 'No Records Found' state renders when the search yields zero results

requirements.title: Admin can view the list of active job vacancies
preconditions: Admin is authenticated (storageState)
At least one active vacancy exists in the system
acceptanceCriteria: Given the Admin is authenticated
When the Admin navigates to /web/index.php/recruitment/viewJobVacancy
Then the vacancies list page loads without error
And the table contains at least one row with vacancy name, job title, and status columns
requirements.expectedOutcome: The recruitment vacancies list renders with at least one vacancy row and no console errors

requirements.title: Login fails with invalid credentials and shows an error
preconditions: No active session exists
The OrangeHRM demo instance is reachable
acceptanceCriteria: Given the login page is displayed
When the user enters an incorrect username or password and clicks Login
Then the page does not navigate away from /web/index.php/auth/login
And an error message containing 'Invalid credentials' is visible
And no session cookie is set
requirements.expectedOutcome: The login page remains active and an error message is displayed; no authenticated session is created

requirements.title: Authenticated user can log out and session is invalidated
preconditions: Admin is authenticated (storageState)
The dashboard page is loaded
acceptanceCriteria: Given the Admin is logged in and on the dashboard
When the Admin opens the user menu and clicks Logout
Then the browser redirects to /web/index.php/auth/login
And navigating back via the browser Back button does not restore the authenticated session
requirements.expectedOutcome: The session is invalidated and the login page is shown; back-navigation does not bypass the login gate

requirements.title: Admin can add a new employee with required fields
preconditions: Admin is authenticated (storageState)
A unique synthetic first and last name is prepared (AutoTest_ prefix)
Cleanup strategy is in place: DELETE /api/v2/pim/employees after test
acceptanceCriteria: Given the Admin is on the Add Employee page at /web/index.php/pim/addEmployee
When the Admin fills in First Name, Last Name, and Employee ID and clicks Save
Then the system creates the employee record and navigates to the employee's personal details page
And the API GET /api/v2/pim/employees returns the newly created employee
And the employee record is deleted via API after the test
requirements.expectedOutcome: New employee record is created and retrievable via API; record is cleaned up after test completion

requirements.title: Admin can update an existing employee's personal details

acceptanceCriteria: Given the Admin is on the personal details page for a known employee

Then a success notification is displayed
And the API GET /api/v2/pim/employees/{id} returns the updated first name
requirements.expectedOutcome: Employee personal details are updated and persisted; the API reflects the change

requirements.title: Admin can view candidate applications for a vacancy
